summary: Session 2026-11-17 (pre-open). Context: SPY -1.91% and QQQ -2.67% Monday, pre-market flat to +0.3%. NVDA closed 156.14 (+1.2% pre) and reports tonight after the close (consensus about $109B revenue, EPS 2.47); I did not pre-position into the binary event. Warsh speaks today, a Dec Fed hike is priced, 10y about 5.1%. Researched: HD (EPS 3.86 vs 3.84, revenue beat, comp guide narrowed to ~1.4%, CEO change, pre -1.9%: no edge), ACM (+25% run-up before the print, +6% pre: skipped), SMWB and SLS (beat/Phase 3 win, priced), KLAR (+1% pre, Q4 guide AOI $100-120M: no clear edge), JD (slight EPS miss, -4%). Trades: long AS (Amer Sports) 7% on a Q3 beat/raise plus $1B buyback after a 5-day slide, pre +5%; long ESLT (Elbit) 5% on a Q3 beat, record $33B backlog and a 2027 high-teens growth guide, pre +8% on thin volume. Both are 10-day post-earnings drift trades with stops of 8% and 10% and targets of 15%. Check next session: the NVDA reaction at the 11-18 open (entry candidate in NVDA/semis only if a base forms), how AS and ESLT held the gap, retail sales and Waller on 11-18, and the Bessent/Nvidia compliance deadline around 11-26. Other watch names: FTNT, INTC and NOW.
feedback: The data was sufficient. Pre-market prints on thin volume (e.g. ESLT +8% on 605 shares, ACM, KNX) are hard to trust, so a pre-market VWAP or a bid/ask indication would help judge the likely opening price. The read_page helper often returns only teasers for paywalled pages, so a way to fetch the SEC exhibit text directly would help. Consensus estimates were not available from the tools and I had to use web search for them.
